title: International Podcast Day and the voices that keep me company
dek: September 30 is International Podcast Day, a good excuse to thank the podcasts that fill my commutes, chores and quiet nights.
body: It is officially September 30, which makes it International Podcast Day. The event started in 2014 as National Podcast Day and was renamed International Podcast Day the next year, with the goal of promoting podcasting around the world.

I did not expect podcasts to become such a steady part of my day. They started as something to listen to on long drives. Now they keep me company while I fold laundry, wash dishes, take a walk, and sometimes while I wind down at night.

What I like most is how personal they feel. A good host sounds like a friend telling you about something they care about. Many of my favorite shows are made by one or two people with a microphone and a lot of curiosity, and that kind of independent work deserves some thanks.

There is also something nice about a medium that lets your eyes rest. After a day of screens, I can close my laptop, put on an episode, and let someone else do the talking while I look out the window.
If a podcast has made your week better, take a minute today to leave it a rating or send an episode to a friend. It costs nothing and helps the people who make it keep going.
